author: olpipi
title: RISC-V build fails: MockMappedMemory::hint_prefetch_async conflicting return type
signature: conflicting return type specified for virtual hint_prefetch_async override|Code Issue

failed_jobs.name: Build (RVV 1.0)
failed_jobs.symptom: Cmake build fails compiling src/core/tests/ov_tensor_test.cpp: GMock MOCK_METHOD conflicting return type for hint_prefetch_async

failed_jobs.name: ci/gha_overall_status_linux_riscv
failed_jobs.symptom: Aggregate status check fails because the Build (RVV 1.0) job failed

key_errors: ../openvino/src/core/tests/ov_tensor_test.cpp:1370:23: error: conflicting return type specified for 'virtual testing::internal::Function<void(long unsigned int, long unsigned int)>::Result ov::test::{anonymous}::MockMappedMemory::hint_prefetch_async(...)'
../openvino/src/common/util/include/openvino/util/mmap_object.hpp:85:33: note: overridden function is 'virtual ov::util::PrefetchToken ov::MappedMemory::hint_prefetch_async(size_t, size_t)'
root_cause: PR #38993 changed the pure-virtual method ov::MappedMemory::hint_prefetch_async in src/common/util/include/openvino/util/mmap_object.hpp from returning void to returning util::PrefetchToken (a handle used to wait on the async prefetch), as part of introducing the PrefetchScheduler feature. The PR did not update the pre-existing MockMappedMemory test double in src/core/tests/ov_tensor_test.cpp (not in the PR's changed-files list), which still declares MOCK_METHOD(void, hint_prefetch_async, (size_t, size_t), (override)). GMock generates a method whose return type must exactly match the overridden virtual, so the mismatched 'void' vs 'util::PrefetchToken' return types trigger a hard compile error (deterministic, every RISC-V/any toolchain build with -Werror compiling this test target).
reproduction_steps: Configure and build ov_core_unit_tests with warnings-as-errors enabled, e.g.: cmake -DENABLE_TESTS=ON -DCMAKE_COMPILE_WARNING_AS_ERROR=ON -S . -B build && cmake --build build --target ov_core_unit_tests. The error reproduces on any platform/toolchain compiling src/core/tests/ov_tensor_test.cpp against the updated mmap_object.hpp interface, not just RISC-V.
recommended_actions: Update the MOCK_METHOD declaration for hint_prefetch_async in src/core/tests/ov_tensor_test.cpp (around line 1370) to MOCK_METHOD(ov::util::PrefetchToken, hint_prefetch_async, (size_t offset, size_t size), (noexcept, override)) to match the new interface signature in mmap_object.hpp:85.
Check for any other mock/stub implementations of MappedMemory in the test tree (e.g. under src/core/tests or src/inference/tests) that may need the same signature update.
Re-run the full unit test build locally with -Werror before pushing to catch similar interface/mock mismatches early.
prevention_strategies: When changing a pure-virtual method's signature (return type, parameters, or noexcept-ness) in a public interface header, grep the whole tree for MOCK_METHOD/MOCK_CONST_METHOD declarations and hand-written overrides of that method and update them in the same commit. Add a CI/pre-commit grep check that flags mock declarations whose signature no longer matches the interface they implement.
historical_context: No prior CI Doctor MQ investigation recorded for this exact signature; this is the first occurrence (count=1) in the pattern database.
